text:
Four sensors, from NASA FIRMS, were checked for fire detections on ASSET-F03 over 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03:

- VIIRS S-NPP
- VIIRS NOAA-20
- VIIRS NOAA-21
- MODIS

All four covered every day of the period, and none returned a thermal detection intersecting the asset (count 0). The VIIRS sensors detect at 375 m resolution and MODIS at 1 km.

This does not prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change, or anything outside this period.
